##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Saturday, 04 July 2026 at 10:45pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure to the south of Ireland as a waving frontal zone affects the north of the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 occasionally 5, especially in east of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the east.


##Weather##

Fair, patchy drizzle possible for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any drizzle.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##

##State of Sea##

##Weather##

Mainly fair, risk of patchy drizzle in places for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in any drizzle.
